title: Town & Country Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Stettler Town and Country Museum is a historic village with a great selection of historical artifacts and buildings telling the story of Stetter’s history. We strive to provide a friendly atmosphere and can assist with local family research. You will find historical information from 1905 to the present day with artifacts such as original photos, newspaper collections, family histories, and more.
hoursText: OPEN Spring/Summer Hours 10 am to 5 pm
